core_thesis.market_pain: TikTok 自然流量靠量取胜，但一条条拍视频成本太高：真人 UGC 一条 100-300 美元，独立开发者和电商卖家耗不起；图文轮播（slideshow）被验证能低成本跑量，可手动做图加多账号发布依然吃时间。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 把跑通的轮播打法做成流水线：模板化生成图文轮播和 AI 钩子视频、自动排期多账号发布，按生成量分层收费（49/95/195 美元）。单条成本压到 0.2-0.5 美元，对比真人 UGC 是数量级差距。复制者应绑定一个品类（如 App 推广、电商选品）做模板库，而不是通用生成器。

deep_dive.opportunity: TikTok reach rewards volume, but human UGC costs $100-$300 per video. Templated photo carousels and AI hook videos at $0.20-$0.50 per asset, auto-published across accounts, close that gap. Bind the template library to one category such as app promotion instead of building a generic generator.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Bulk automation can trip platform policies, so publish through official APIs with human review. Credit systems confuse users; keep one simple allowance. Revenue figures are founder-reported.
workflow: Phase 01: Pick one promotion category and collect 20 proven carousel formats from live accounts.
Phase 02: Build a template engine that renders carousels and hook videos, then schedules posts across connected accounts.
Phase 03: Price by monthly volume with growth, scale and agency tiers; allow unlimited accounts and seats.
Phase 04: Dogfood your own account matrix, publish revenue milestones, and recruit the first 10 paying operators.

en.summary: Automates TikTok photo carousels and AI UGC hook videos with multi-account scheduling, priced $49-$195/month by volume; founder reports $30K+/month after a $44K peak.
en.title: TikTok Slideshow Automation: Templated Volume at $0.50 per Asset
en.verdict: Clear unit-economics wedge against human UGC, but platform policy risk and founder-reported numbers keep it at C tier.

pitfalls_to_avoid: 多账号自动发布必须走官方接口并保留人工审核，批量刷量有封号风险，卖点写清合规边界；双货币额度系统被用户吐槽看不懂，用单一额度更稳；收入数字为创始人自述，定价和宣传别照搬峰值。
summary: 把 TikTok 图文轮播和 AI 钩子视频做成自动流水线：模板生成、多账号排期发布，按量订阅 49/95/195 美元三档；创始人自述峰值月入 4.4 万美元、稳态 3 万美元以上（C 级证据）。复制者绑定单品类模板库，务实目标月入 1500-5000 美元。
summary_en: Automates TikTok carousels and AI hook videos with multi-account scheduling at $49-$195/month; founder reports $30K+/month.

workflow_steps.deliverable: 单品类 20 个跑通的轮播版式
workflow_steps.detail: 选一个推广品类（如独立 App），拆解 20 条真实跑量的轮播结构：钩子句、图序、结尾引导。版式库就是护城河，通用生成器没人续费。
workflow_steps.title: 拆解跑量版式库

workflow_steps.deliverable: 生成加排期的自动化 MVP
workflow_steps.detail: 模板引擎渲染轮播图和钩子视频，接入 TikTok 官方接口做多账号排期发布；先人工审核后发布，自动化只做生成和排期。
workflow_steps.title: 模板生成 + 官方接口排期

workflow_steps.detail: 49 美元 100 条、95 美元 250 条、195 美元 750 条，账号和席位不限；额度只用一种货币，避免用户算不清账流失。

workflow_steps.deliverable: 自营矩阵验证与首批付费用户
workflow_steps.detail: 先用自己的账号矩阵跑出真实播放和转化数据，公开里程碑吸引同品类运营者；前 10 个付费用户靠一对一带跑成交。
